description: This file contains shell script functions for QMI protocol management within a network interface configuration. It includes functions to initialize configuration, set up the interface with the QMI device, and tear down the connection. The script interacts with a QMI-based device to manage network registration, PIN verification, and data connection establishment, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 configurations.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the QMI protocol configuration by defining available options and defaults.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Sets up the QMI network interface, handling device initialization, PIN verification, network registration, and IP configuration for both IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the QMI network interface, stopping active connections and releasing resources.
